LanguageData.Gun_Beretta_92fs_Inox_RWP.label: Beretta 92FS Inox
LanguageData.Gun_Beretta_92fs_Inox_RWP.description: The Beretta 92FS Inox is a semi-automatic pistol known for its reliability and precision. Featuring stainless steel construction, it offers enhanced durability and resistance to corrosion. This weapon provides a balance of firepower and accuracy, making it a favored sidearm in combat.
